description: Adds `WithConfiguration(...)` for customizing the generated Kubernetes `PersistentVolumeClaim` for first-class persistent volumes, plus `WithoutStorageClass()` and polyglot `WithPersistentVolumeName(...)` for claiming existing volumes. This lets callers mutate claim metadata and spec fields not covered by the existing volume configuration methods.
name: Customizable Kubernetes PersistentVolumeClaims
